notes.title: Chinese translation is here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I hope you are doing well, the Chinese version of Save Me Sakuya + Remilia DLC is here! If your steam language is set to Chinese, it should automatically be downloaded, if not, then right click the game in your steam library, go to properties, and select Chinese from the languages tab! You may need to restart steam to see the option.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40561527/60f8f7c07cd1b6faca3be1088c7a0f82f351996a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40561527/b889f021bc5ba1b917d7b29de31c706b57e37794.jpg[/img]

I hope this translation will be helpful! Please let me know your thoughts on it. Take care and have a wonderful day.

notes.title: Trading Cards, Wallpapers And Badges Are Here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I have exciting news to announce! Trading cards, along with wallpapers and badges are now here for Save Me, Sakuya-San! If you have enough hours in the game, the cards should already be available in your inventory.

Wallpapers include these adorable plush dolls of Remilia and Patchouli featured in the game! So cuute!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40561527/bb736b1f0121c66cbb4f9f18915a0644e85591b8.jpg[/img]

Thank you and have a wonderful day!

notes.title: Vote For Save Me, Sakuya-San In The Steam Awards! + STEAM SALE!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I hope you're all doing well,  Save Me, Sakuya-san! Has been released for a few months now and I would like to say thank you all so much for your overwhelming support! I am absolutely humbled and grateful . I promise this won't be the last you'll see of Sakuya and the MC!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40561527/3cfcd1b5bc6af0dfb62bdc5af9e9fd686b915197.png[/img]
I have read every single review for the game and it genuinely brightens my day to read about how the game relaxes or cheers you guys up!

Today, I'm doing a week long sale for SMS and I humbly ask you to consider nominating it for the "Sit Back And Relax" You should automatically be able to do it within this announcement, so if you enjoyed SMS, do consider it and tell your friends!

While you're at it, you can also check out my other games too, they're ALL on sale and if you liked SMS I guarantee you'll love these too!

Sakuya Izayoi Gives You Advice And Dabs: Feel relaxed into this mental vacation as Sakuya Izayoi from the Touhou Project guides you through your troubles by offering helpful advice and strategies to help you feel at ease.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1232180/Sakuya_Izayoi_Gives_You_Advice_And_Dabs/

CBT With Yuuka Kazami: Yuuka Kazami from the Touhou Project invites you to some mostly peaceful lessons where you grasp the basics of CBT!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1430420/CBT_With_Yuuka_Kazami/

My Inner Darkness Is A Hot Anime Girl!: 3D turn-based RPG game featuring surreal enemy designs and dream-like locations, packed into a gripping story about overcoming intrusive thoughts! ON SALE HERE: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1753050/My_Inner_Darkness_Is_A_Hot_Anime_Girl/

Twilight Town: A Cyberpunk Day In Life: A beautiful visual novel about the life of a man obsessed with his A.I waifu in a dark and seedy town.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1572990/Twilight_Town_A_Cyberpunk_Day_In_Life/


You can check out the rest of my other games HERE: 
https://store.steampowered.com/dev/sigyaad

notes.title: Big update + Sale!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! A big update has been pushed for Save Me, Sakuya-san! And to coincide with this update, a discount for this game and all of my other games will commence! 

The main features of the update are as follows: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40561527/3cfcd1b5bc6af0dfb62bdc5af9e9fd686b915197.png[/img]

[b][list]
[*] The game now plays at a much higher resolution! 
[*]  The crashing and freezing problems have been fixed! The game should not crash, freeze or hang up anymore! 
[*] Some small missing dialogue that didn't play due to a bug have been fixed
[*] A proper credits screen in-game! You can check out a neatly formatted credits list of all the songs and some assets used from the title screen 
[*] A cute little splash screen will show up when you launch the game!
[/list] [/b]

If for whatever reason, you want to go back to the older version of the game, enter the code "olddinosaur21" in the beta tab of the game and you will be granted access to the older version.

Once again I'd like to remind you that Save Me, Sakuya-San and all my other games are ON SALE RIGHT NOW! So pick them up or gift them to a friend! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1639610/Save_Me_Sakuyasan/

I also have an upcoming game you're free to check out too! It's a 3D turn based JRPG with a heart throbbing story and a awesome soundtrack! Wish list it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1753050/My_Inner_Darkness_Is_A_Hot_Anime_Girl/

notes.title: Remilia Scarlet DLC Announced!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I hope you're doing well! I'm pleased to announce that a continuation to the story in the form of DLC has been released! It features a bit of gameplay with everyone's favourite vampire and head of the Scarlet Devil Mansion, Remilia Scarlet! Wish list it here! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1695230/Save_Me_Sakuyasan_Remilia_Scarlets_Coin_And_Glass_Game/

Additionally, a bit of a clean-up update will happen for Save Me, Sakuya-San in the future! This update will fix a lot of bugs and crashing and add some quality of life features like an upscaled resolution and  the song credits list being available in the title screen instead of having to go into the game directory to view it! I aim to have this update by early-mid august! 

Thank you for all of your support! I hope you enjoy this DLC when it comes out! Take care and have a wonderful day!
